panels.description: Ada climbs a service stair above the clouds using the access tool Alex threw to her. She follows her own previously marked route; Oasis opens beyond the stairwell. Leave upper area clear.
Ada's old route mark aligns with a maintenance map leading to a pale civic apartment. The physical mark, map and her hand remain clear; do not include Lina or any Lina-associated route.
An escort drone turns toward Ada on the service stair. Leave upper space for its alert sound.
Ada covers her identity band with the access tool as the drone passes. Leave upper-left clear for her line.
